passages.text: That which was from the beginning, which we have heard, which we have seen with our own eyes, which we have gazed upon and touched with our own hands—this is the Word of life.
passages.sermon:
The Word of life existed from the beginning.
We heard the Word of life.
We saw the Word of life with our own eyes.
We looked closely at the Word of life.
We touched the Word of life with our own hands.
passages.original: Ὃ ἦν ἀπ’ ἀρχῆς ὃ ἀκηκόαμεν ὃ ἑωράκαμεν τοῖς ὀφθαλμοῖς ἡμῶν ὃ ἐθεασάμεθα καὶ αἱ χεῖρες ἡμῶν ἐψηλάφησαν περὶ τοῦ Λόγου τῆς ζωῆς

passages.text: And this is the life that was revealed; we have seen it and testified to it, and we proclaim to you the eternal life that was with the Father and was revealed to us.
passages.sermon:
God revealed life to us.
We saw this life.
We testify about this life.
We proclaim this eternal life to you.
This eternal life was with the Father.
God revealed this eternal life to us.
passages.original: καὶ ἡ ζωὴ ἐφανερώθη καὶ ἑωράκαμεν καὶ μαρτυροῦμεν καὶ ἀπαγγέλλομεν ὑμῖν τὴν ζωὴν τὴν αἰώνιον ἥτις ἦν πρὸς τὸν Πατέρα καὶ ἐφανερώθη ἡμῖν

passages.text: We proclaim to you what we have seen and heard, so that you also may have fellowship with us. And this fellowship of ours is with the Father and with His Son, Jesus Christ.
passages.sermon:
We have seen and heard the Word of life.
We proclaim this to you.
We do this so you may have fellowship with us.
Our fellowship is with the Father.
Our fellowship is also with His Son, Jesus Christ.
passages.original: ὃ ἑωράκαμεν καὶ ἀκηκόαμεν ἀπαγγέλλομεν καὶ ὑμῖν ἵνα καὶ ὑμεῖς κοινωνίαν ἔχητε μεθ’ ἡμῶν καὶ ἡ κοινωνία δὲ ἡ ἡμετέρα μετὰ τοῦ Πατρὸς καὶ μετὰ τοῦ Υἱοῦ αὐτοῦ Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ

passages.text: We write these things so that our joy may be complete.
passages.sermon: We write these things.\r\nWe want our joy to be complete.
passages.original: καὶ ταῦτα γράφομεν ἡμεῖς ἵνα ἡ χαρὰ ἡμῶν ᾖ πεπληρωμένη

passages.text: And this is the message we have heard from Him and announce to you: God is light, and in Him there is no darkness at all.
passages.sermon:
We heard a message from Jesus Christ.
We now announce this message to you.
God is light.
There is no darkness in God at all.
passages.original: Καὶ ἔστιν αὕτη ἡ ἀγγελία ἣν ἀκηκόαμεν ἀπ’ αὐτοῦ καὶ ἀναγγέλλομεν ὑμῖν ὅτι ὁ Θεὸς φῶς ἐστιν καὶ σκοτία ἐν αὐτῷ οὐκ ἔστιν οὐδεμία

passages.text: If we say we have fellowship with Him yet walk in the darkness, we lie and do not practice the truth.
passages.sermon:
God is light.  
God has no darkness in Him at all.  
If we say we have fellowship with God, we must live in the light.  
If we walk in darkness, we do not live as God wants.  
If we claim fellowship with God but walk in darkness, we lie.  
We do not practice the truth if we walk in darkness.
passages.original: Ἐὰν εἴπωμεν ὅτι κοινωνίαν ἔχομεν μετ’ αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐν τῷ σκότει περιπατῶμεν ψευδόμεθα καὶ οὐ ποιοῦμεν τὴν ἀλήθειαν

passages.text: But if we walk in the light as He is in the light, we have fellowship with one another, and the blood of Jesus His Son cleanses us from all sin.
passages.sermon:
God is light.
God has no darkness in Him.
Jesus is God's Son.
If we walk in the light, we follow God's way.
God Himself is always in the light.
If we walk in the light as God does, we have fellowship with each other.
The blood of Jesus, God's Son, cleanses us from all sin.
passages.original: ἐὰν δὲ ἐν τῷ φωτὶ περιπατῶμεν ὡς αὐτός ἐστιν ἐν τῷ φωτί κοινωνίαν ἔχομεν μετ’ ἀλλήλων καὶ τὸ αἷμα Ἰησοῦ τοῦ Υἱοῦ αὐτοῦ καθαρίζει ἡμᾶς ἀπὸ πάσης ἁμαρτίας

passages.text: If we say we have no sin, we deceive ourselves, and the truth is not in us.
passages.sermon: Every person has sinned.\r\nIf we say we have no sin, we deceive ourselves.\r\nThe truth is not in us.
passages.original: Ἐὰν εἴπωμεν ὅτι ἁμαρτίαν οὐκ ἔχομεν ἑαυτοὺς πλανῶμεν καὶ ἡ ἀλήθεια οὐκ ἔστιν ἐν ἡμῖν

passages.text: If we confess our sins, He is faithful and just to forgive us our sins and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness.
passages.sermon:
God is faithful.
God is just.
If we confess our sins, God forgives our sins.
God cleanses us from all unrighteousness.
passages.original: ἐὰν ὁμολογῶμεν τὰς ἁμαρτίας ἡμῶν πιστός ἐστιν καὶ δίκαιος ἵνα ἀφῇ ἡμῖν τὰς ἁμαρτίας καὶ καθαρίσῃ ἡμᾶς ἀπὸ πάσης ἀδικίας

passages.text: If we say we have not sinned, we make Him out to be a liar, and His word is not in us.
passages.sermon:
Every person has sinned.
If we say we have not sinned, we speak falsely.
We make God out to be a liar.
God’s word is not in us.
passages.original: ἐὰν εἴπωμεν ὅτι οὐχ ἡμαρτήκαμεν ψεύστην ποιοῦμεν αὐτὸν καὶ ὁ λόγος αὐτοῦ οὐκ ἔστιν ἐν ἡμῖν
